title: The Big Dash
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 continues (Learning), 60-sound stage (gl, gr, pl just added).

pages.text: Nell and Pip get set to dash.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee and Pip the sparrow lined up side by side at the edge of the stream, ready to race.

pages.text: Nell and Pip dash and dash.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee and Pip the sparrow racing fast along the bank of the stream.

pages.text: Pip is quick. Nell is quick too.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Nell the bee neck and neck, both moving fast.
Nell the bee grinning over at Pip the sparrow mid-race.
Pip the sparrow reaching a fallen log just ahead of Nell.
Nell the bee landing just behind the log, looking a little disappointed.

pages.text: Pip grins and claps for Nell.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow clapping his wings together, grinning warmly at Nell.

pages.text: Nell and Pip sit and grin.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee and Pip the sparrow sitting together on the log, both grinning.

pages.text: It was fun, not a big win.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee and Pip the sparrow resting happily together by the stream, the race forgotten.
